messages:
alex (Sales): Heads up 1 I'm taking a 12-week assignment in Toronto starting May 3. Is this considered a temporary relocation vs permanent? Need clarity on payroll and WFH stipend.
maya (People Ops): Since this crosses the border and is >30 days, it's a temporary relocation but will trigger more checks. Please complete the homebase-declare form and mark "international temporary". We'll engage payroll and our tax partner.
alex (Sales): If it's temporary, does Redwood cover laptop shipping and any customs fees?
equip-bot: For international temporary moves, standard policy covers shipping up to $150 and insurance. Customs fees are employee responsibility unless pre-approved by manager. Attach passport/ID and customs declaration in ticket.
alex (Sales): Understood. Filing deadlines? I need to know if I should delay the move until HR finishes review.
omar (Finance): Cross-border temp assignments can affect payroll withholding and benefits. We usually need at least 10 business days to set up foreign withholding flags and review tax treaty implications. Payroll will confirm whether your pay needs to be rerouted or if gross-up applies.
maya (People Ops): Also check visa/work authorization. If you'll be working for a Canadian entity vs US, that's a different process. People Ops will coordinate with Legal if needed.
alex (Sales): What's the WFH stipend situation for an international move? prorated like domestic?
omar (Finance): Yes, stipend is prorated. However, some countries have fringe benefit reporting rules; payroll will advise if stipend needs to be grossed up or reported as taxable in Canada.
alex (Sales): I submitted the form. hr-bot: "homebase-declare" submitted by alex at 1758009999.
maya (People Ops): Got it. Please open an equipment ticket for shipping request.
alex (Sales): Created EQ-8822 and attached passport scan.
equip-bot: EQ-8822 received. Manager pre-approval required for customs coverage.
omar (Finance): We'll start the payroll review and post an update in this thread with any withholding changes within 7 business days.
alex (Sales): Thanks; looping in my manager. Will wait to schedule final travel until payroll confirms.
hr-bot: Payroll review opened (PR-10121). Estimated update by 1758010065."
